instruction: Convert this MicroStrategy cube SQL metric with a filter condition into a Power BI DAX measure.
input:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id)
FROM fact_sales
WHERE customer_segment = 'Premium'
output:
Premium Customer Count = 
CALCULATE(
    DISTINCTCOUNT(fact_sales[customer_id]),
    fact_sales[customer_segment] = "Premium"
)

instruction: Convert this MicroStrategy time-intelligence metric into a Power BI DAX measure.
input:
Metric: Payroll Cost YTD
Expression: SUM(gross_pay) year-to-date based on pay_period
output:
Payroll Cost YTD = 
TOTALYTD(
    SUM(fact_payroll[gross_pay]),
    DIM_DATE[date]
)
